verdict.rationale: Cursor Automations run cloud agents in the background. They trigger on a schedule (presets or cron) or on events from GitHub, GitLab, Slack, webhooks and Linear. They can be created in plain language via the /automate skill, from the Agents Window or cursor.com/automations, or from Marketplace templates. Cursor-managed agents like Bugbot and team-owned service-account execution round this out, and cloud agents run without the local machine connected. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably in practice.
